title: Personal Finance Tracker with AI Based Expense Prediction
authors: Chandana, M.; Manoj Vardhan Reddy, E.; Praveen Reddy, E.; Siri Vaishnavi, I.; Vaishnavi, K.
venue: American Journal of Management and IoT Medical Computing
tldr: An AI-powered personal finance tracker combining Random Forest for expense classification and LSTM for time-series forecasting demonstrates improved financial awareness compared to traditional static trackers.
problem_and_motivation: Traditional expense trackers record transactions but fail to provide analytical insights or budgeting guidance, limiting users to surface-level understanding of their finances.
approach: Built using Python Flask framework with MySQL database for transaction storage and management.
Random Forest algorithm classifies transactions into categories such as food, travel, rent, and entertainment.
LSTM deep learning model forecasts future monthly expenses based on historical transaction data.
Anomaly detection component analyzes spending trends to identify unusual or excessive spending patterns.
Interactive dashboard provides graphical reports including bar charts, pie charts, and line graphs.
Data preprocessing module cleans transaction data, handles null values, and normalizes datasets.
findings: num: LSTM model achieved around 85% accuracy in forecasting next-month expenses.
num: Random Forest classifier reached above 90% accuracy in transaction categorization.
Predicted values closely matched actual spending patterns for most categories.
Anomaly detection identified sudden spending spikes and irregular transactions with good accuracy.
Users found the dashboard interface easy to understand and useful for financial awareness.
